title: Studio, Nashville Margaritaville
description:
You won’t have to head all the way to the Caribbean to find your lost shaker of salt. In fact, it’s right upstairs at the resort’s rooftop bar. Lounge poolside until the sun hangs low, take it easy by the fire pit, and see panoramic views of downtown as live music loosens your mood. Hit the area honky-tonks, then relax back in your island-themed suite — where more drinks await with the help of your Frozen Concoction Maker.

Rates and availability vary, so contact host to inquire about your dates
